note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the performances are generic placeholders, never real contract text. The two rooms differ in one supplied fact only: the column the changed performance is listed in. A link means only "linked as supplied": no exchange that is due, no condition, no dependency, no order of performance, no breach, remedy or termination, and no jurisdiction is stated. No winner, score or outcome. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): clauses (the performances stand for the clauses), schedules, definitions and priorities (no priority between the columns is drawn). Stress cap (coordinator decision, standing stress cap rule, AUTHORING item 20, 2026-09-26): long-labels-stress lists one shared performance per column, as the baseline does (counts equal, never fewer); every text field stays strictly longer than the baseline's. True driver: 1:1 — with two shared performances per column (three rows with the changed card) and the changed card at least 70 px tall, even the closest of the 1:1 arrangements tried (rooms side by side with the people beside or under the boards, printed or print-bar cards; rooms stacked beside a right-hand panel) overruns the room's top by 140 design units (about 104 px at 1080p), at every text size down to the 16 px floor; 16:9 and 9:16 fit uncapped. Pre-cap copy: production/scratch/contract-terms-03/LAW-0491.presets.precap.json.
